name: Receipt
description: The receipt of a paid invoice. Nobody writes one by hand in the walk-through: the Invoice sample's rule creates it when an invoice enters paid, through the outbox.
title: "Receipt for " & invoice

invoice.label: Invoice
invoice.description: The id of the paid invoice this receipt is for.

amount.label: Amount
amount.description: What was paid: the invoice's total when it entered paid.

descriptions.issued: The receipt stands for the payment.
descriptions.voided: Finance took the receipt back. It is kept, and changes no more.

transitions.name: void
transitions.label: Void
transitions.description: Finance takes the receipt back, when the payment it stands for did not happen.
